scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with tall buildings lining both sides, featuring a tree growing out of the sidewalk and a black trashcan on the curb. The street has a crosswalk and a pedestrian crossing signal. A person is seen walking down the street in the distance. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are multi-story structures with balconies and windows. They have a mix of beige and white facades.
scene_analysis.materials: The tree has a thick trunk and branches that extend upwards.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and lampposts along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The tree has green leaves and a few scattered leaves on the ground.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a yellow sign with a red figure of a person.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears quiet and peaceful.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area is scenic and picturesque.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is clean and well-maintained.
